notes.title: Official Patch Notes 0.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fog no longer has limit moving forward.
- Thrown beer bottle now only damages once.
- Bug Fixes on player death

Balances
- Decreased Pipe Bomb Fuse time.

Additions
- Added simple character editor in main menu.
- Added random ammo crate to loot drop.
- Added another simple soundtrack.
- Added ui icons for activated perks along with context.
- Added shootable fire hydrant that blows enemies away.
- Added explosive that can be shot.

Notes
- Zombie model stretched when playing "getting up" animation.
- Oblivious Zombie still jittery during roaming walk animation.

notes.title: Official Patch Notes 0.4
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed auto equipping next weapon in hotkey after throwing current weapon.
- Fixed not being able to push with Bottle equipped.

Balances
- Increase base loot drop chance to 70% (was 50%)
- Player starts with full health and stamina and half food and water.

Additions
- Pushing zombies into cars are now fatal.
- Added car wobble animation when in contact with zombie.
- Added Alert icon on top of cursor to show machete is broken.
- Added UI bar fillers for reloading and extracting bullets from weapon.
- Added new weapon Pipe Bomb.
- Added throwing arc visual for Bottle And Pipe Bomb.
- Added more sounds for reloading/extracting ammo.
- Added Out Of Stamina Icon above cursor when performing an action without stamina.
- Inventory can now be closed when clicked outside of UI.
- Getting hit now closes inventory if open.
- Added Reset button on main menu to reset scores.

To (Maybe Discuss) Do List / Ideas
- Polish up player death.
- Add Sniper.
- Walker Zombies are jittery when roaming, fix animation/physics problem.
- Add language accessability.
- Add sound to car being bumped
- Test for longest distance and recent distance saved data.
- Increase car generation
- Add more interactables for the environment.
- Create groups of zombies.
- Create different zombie types (Instead of speed change only)
- Need to add sound generation for all firearms.
- Add bullet eject effect after shooting.
- Add weapon magazine eject after reloading.
- Add chainsaw weapon + gas ammo for chainsaw.
- Add player sounds (grunts, screams, damages etc)

notes.title: Official Patch Notes 0.3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Resized main canvas UI (Now works with resize).
- Changed weapon throw to middle mouse button.
- Foxed zombies still damaging player after being defeated.
- Respawning after first death freezed gameplay, fixed.
- Shadows were pixelated, switched to high quality.

Balances
- Increased pistol ammo upgrade to increments of 3 (Was 2).
- increase zombie damage to 20 (Was 10).

Additions
- Added ammo HUD for Pistol, Lmg , AK, Pump Shotgun.
- Added reduce chance to break machete perk card.
- Added increased machete attack speed perk card.
- Added polishing on UI.
- Added reload and ammo extract for Pistol.
- Added reload and ammo extract for AK.
- Added reload and ammo extract for LMG.
- Added reload and ammo extract from Pump Shotgun.
- Every weapon now has their own aiming speed.
- Added second soundtrack
- Eating and drinking creates particle FX (was a whole screen FX).
- Added high score and most recent score to main menu (saved data).
- Added controls on top right of screen to show main buttons.

To Do List
- Add pushing enemies into cars fatal.
- Add clear notification of machete break icon above player.
- Add interaction bar filler for reload and extract functions.
- Add throwing line for bottle.
- Auto equipping function after throwing bottle is broken.
- Test for longest distance and recent distance saved data.
- Player will sometimes permanently rubber band to executable target.
- Add more interactables for the environemnt.
- Add grenades.
- Add bullet eject effect after shooting.
- Add relaod sounds for shotgun.
- Add clear indicator for Out Of Stamina.
- Add chainsaw weapon + gas ammo for chainsaw.
- Need to add reload sounds for reloading and extracting ammo.
- Need to add exit inventroy event when clicking out of inventory or getting damaged.
- Polish up player death.
- Polish main menu UI.
- Add Sniper.
- Walker Zombies are jittery when roaming, fix animation/physics problem.
- Add language accessability.

notes.title: Official Patch Notes 0.2
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed resolution problem of UI for 2560 x 1080.
- Weapon shot audio now overlaps.
- Zombie spawning capped at 1400m Mark fixed by adjusting max number of zombies bug.

Balances:
- Reduced loot drop chance according to players loot drop chance.
- Loot spawn is now split into categories with weapons having a lower chance of spawning.
- Reduced stamina cost of machete to 5.

Addition: 
- Changed item pick up system. Pressing the interact button picks up closes item to player.
- Added Perk Card for AK (Increased Aim Speed).
- Added Perk Cards for Shotgun (Increase pellet amount, Increase ammo found).
- Added Perl Cards for LMG (Increase LMG Handling, Increase ammo found).

To Do List:
- Create perk card for machete to attack while moving.
- Add interactable environments.
- Add ammo system (extract ammo).
- Add reloading, shotgun pump and extracting ammo animations.
- Change weapon throw to Middle Mouse.
- Fix color FX bug when drinking and eating consumables.
- Add grenades.
- Polish perk Cards UI.
- Polish main menu UI.
- Add Sniper.
- Walker Zombies are jittery when roaming, fix animation/physics problem.
- Add more music
- Add language accessability
